findings.title: RentalService doc comment is stale after hourly rentals
findings.why: The comment says every period covers whole days, from midnight to midnight UTC. Hourly rentals shorter than a day are now supported. The `RentalRequest` and `AvailabilityQuery` field comments (lines 16, 18, 41, 43) also say midnight UTC only.

findings.title: The cancel bullet sits after the hourly-rentals paragraph
findings.why: `cancel` is a list item of the rental API, but it comes after the free-text hourly paragraph, far from the other bullets. It reads as part of the hourly section, and the bullet list is no longer contiguous.
